verdict: The numbers in the three files are sound: I found no critical error and no headline number or verdict that is wrong. All three generated tables re-create verbatim from the result files, both RESULT reports are byte-identical to template plus regenerated tables, and 46 engine re-runs reproduced the stored values with zero difference (largest gap 4e-6, CSV rounding). The pre-registration hash and all 14 upload hash prefixes match, and every "reported" figure (58.4% / -55.1%, 48.0%, 62.0%, 77.6%, 48.9%, v10 2022 -40%) is in the uploaded reports. Two major wording problems must be fixed before the report is final. First, conclusion 2 of the full report calls PRESET_A's +0.5~+1.2%p the "most favourable condition", while the report's own sections show up to +4.1/+4.6 (M, 0.30bp) and +4.7/+5.9 (H). Second, the program spec states as fact that 62%, 77.6% and 48.9% come from the look-ahead calculation, although the verification lanes marked exactly those figures as untested. The rest are minor: two rounding slips, a wrong window count for T5, a wrong file path, one misattributed figure, summary ranges that leave out lane variants, status labels stronger than the lane's, and a few caveats the lanes raised that the reports drop.
